title: Implement source-bound BIT old-low carry descriptor frontend (partial lowering)
body:
## Summary

```text
actual old-low cache + binary Q
  -> five-tape finite decoder and paid dispatch
  -> new-low word + exact binary (C+1)
```

Prove the source-specific carry envelope `C=k/4 mod Q`, `-7<=k<=12`, for both directions of helper462/frame506's `S8 tensor I_f`, and implement the descriptor frontend with explicit compiler and runtime costs. Retain pinned predecessor bytes and attribution.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR4989 computes carries through host arithmetic; PR5019 accepts an already supplied descriptor and preserves its earlier high axis. **After:** the literal frontend matches the independent source oracle in 148 cases, including inverse and f=2 strided caches; 240 descriptor cases include 40-bit moduli. The admitted `I+3e05` low matrix exposes a first-high-coordinate carry requiring a separately paid two-OLD-swap repair.
- Registered package replay passes normal and `-O`, with 11 semantic controls and retained-source authentication: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-low-carry-lowering`.
- Partial result only: full payload low-type permutation, cache retirement, output installation and complete route composition remain unimplemented. The OLD repair is a conditional invoice. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Isolated additive package; existing suppliers and selected records are unchanged. JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; predecessor credit and Apache-2.0 notices retained.

## Task, overlap and remaining work

Task `b2_bit_low_type_carry_lowering` / `uniform-transfer-audit`; [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4945#discussioncomment-19140932). Scientific base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, priority revision 7. The delivered scope is explicitly narrower than the original complete-adapter objective; the README and PROOF record the unimplemented obligations and Open next questions.

Pre-submission checkpoint: canonical main `ff3cc58e3` was fetched on 2026-10-23; governing guidance and selected record are unchanged. Fresh advisory overlap covered 371 open PRs and 4587 discussion records with complete reported pagination; no competing implementation of this precise scoped result was found. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside this coverage. Official metadata, committed-byte/source-history, package export/check and optimized Git-free replay pass. A separate Astra source/proof review found no remaining actionable issue at the submitted head. This is scoped AI-assisted evidence, not human/proof-kernel acceptance.
